column1: # An agent's signature check (the agent signature contract): agent-sig(key, method, path, body, header, now, window) → ok or a refusal word.
# input — the input of the command agent-sig as JSON text: key — the hex of a member's public Ed25519; method, path (without query), body — the text of the body;
# header — the value of X-Agent-Signature (empty — there is no header); for — the value of X-Agent-For, optional; now — the checker's wall-clock seconds; window — the door's window (300 or 60).
# expect — {"result":"ok"} or {"result":"refused","reason":<слово>}. The rows — the acceptance inputs of М11/3 inputs/agent-sig-*.json, sc. 10.
